observations.title: InFocus This Week: Google Skills Arcade February 2026
observations.text_excerpt: This week’s update is a big one—and a meaningful step forward in how the Google Skills Arcade feels, flows, and supports learning. If you’ve ever felt the quiet pressure of “What’s the next level?” or “Am I ready to move up?”, this change is for you. A simpler, more open way to play and learn. We’re officially moving away from Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3. Instead, the Google Skills Arcade is now level-agnostic, which means you choose your own path. There’s no fixed order and no invisible ladder to climb. You can move forward based on your interests, comfort, and learning goals. This shift is designed to create a more fair and stress-free learning experience. It also helps make participation more uniform across games, balancing capacity and reducing unnecessary pressure on specific challenges. What’s changed? Arcade Adventure Earlier Level 1, this track will focus on hands-on games that help you explore Google Cloud tools and concepts at your own pace. Arcade Voyage Earlier Level 2, these practice-focused challenges will help you strengthen and apply your cloud skills with growing confidence. Arcade Trail Earlier Level 3, this track will focus on AI skills, helping you understand and apply AI concepts and tools when you feel ready. Arcade Sprint – Trivia Earlier Trivia, these quick quizzes will help you refresh key concepts while earning Arcade Points. Why this matters Learning shouldn’t feel like a race or a checklist. With this new structure, you can choose challenges that genuinely interest you, revisit topics without feeling like you’re moving backward, and build skills in a way that feels natural and sustainable. The Google Skills Arcade is now less about levels and more about learning momentum. Choose your path, play your way, and keep building skills that matter. See you in the Cloud! P.S. Along with these changes, you might have already seen new badge designs rolling out. We hope you like how they look and feel as you collect them.

observations.title: Google Skills Arcade 2026: Prize Counter Update
observations.text_excerpt: If you’ve been part of our Google Skills Arcade family for a while, you know the rhythm we’ve shared: the excitement of two Prize Counter openings every year. It’s been our favorite way to celebrate the miles you’ve covered. This year, the road has a bit of a detour. Due to some persistent shipping constraints that are out of our hands , we’re moving to a single, unified Prize Counter opening at the end of this year . Instead of two windows, we’ll have one focused moment to redeem your points and grab your swag. We know this feels like a big shift. Having only one chance to claim your rewards is a change we didn’t take lightly, and we truly understand if it feels a little bittersweet. Your patience means the world to us while we navigate these logistics to make sure your rewards actually reach you. The Win You Carry With You While the prize window is changing, the heart of the Google Skills Arcade remains exactly where it’s always been. We’ve always said that the best things you “win” here don’t come in a box: The Skills are Yours: Every lab you tackle and every complex challenge you overcome is a permanent power-up for your future in the cloud. Growing Every Day: The Google Skills Arcade isn’t just about the finish line; it’s about the curiosity and grit you show every time you log in. Always Learning: The opportunity to build, explore, and level up is still wide open, every single day of the year. What’s Popping Up Next? We aren’t just shifting the calendar; we’re also refocusing on what makes the Google Skills Arcade special. Moving to a single redemption window will allow us to ensure that the rewards experience is meaningful, sustainable, and, above all, fair for everyone. To support this longer journey, the number of points required for each tier may be increased, and we are currently polishing a new Prize Tier structure designed to celebrate true progress. We want to ensure that the Google Skills Arcade remains a space for those who are genuinely here to learn and build. While swag is a fun part of the journey, it’s the skills and the integrity of the community that matter most. This new structure is our way of making sure that your hard work and dedication are recognized in a way that is fair to everyone. We’ll be sharing the full details of these new tiers with you very soon, so please stay tuned. Thank you for the heart you bring to this community. We see the real work you’re doing in every lab and every challenge, and we’re so proud to be a part of your learning story. Keep exploring. Keep building. Most importantly, keep growing! See You In The Cloud!

observations.title: Google Skills Arcade 2026 Tiers
observations.text_excerpt: Big news day! We are finally announcing the Google Skills Arcade 2026 prize tiers. We know how much thought and strategy you all put into building your skills and earning your badges, so we wanted to give you the exact blueprint early enough to plan your ultimate path to the top. Grab your favorite snack, check out the milestones below, and let’s start plotting your route to that dream Arcade Tier! We want to make sure the rewards go exactly where they belong: to genuine learners putting in real effort on a level playing field. To do that, we’ve optimized our prize system with two major updates this season: Outgrowing the Training Wheels: The Novice tier has officially left the building! Let’s be real—since this is a full, year-long journey, none of you are going to stay a novice in the Cloud. You’re all leveling up way too fast, so we’re focusing all our rewards on the four major milestones below. Limited Spots (With Plenty of Room!): For the first time, we are putting a limit on how many people can get prizes in each tier. But please don’t worry! We looked at last year’s numbers and made sure these new limits are much higher than the total amount of prizes people actually claimed last year. As long as you are playing fair, growing your cloud skills, and earning your badges, there is plenty of room for you to get your rewards! The Arcade Prize Counter will operate on a strict first-come, first-served basis starting from the Legend Tier. To make sure your hard work is rewarded, we are using a “Waterfall System” for prize distribution. If a tier’s prize pool fills up before you can claim it, you don’t lose out—your eligibility safely rolls down to the next tier below. The 2026 Arcade Tier Breakdown: Arcade Legend Tier (120+ Arcade Points) The very first 2,500 players to reach this tier get Legend prizes. Once these 2,500 spots are gone, anyone else with 120+ points automatically “waterfalls” down to the Champion Tier pool. Arcade Champion Tier (95–119 Arcade Points) The first 3,000 players to secure a spot (including those rolling down from the Legend Tier) get Arcade Champion prizes. If this fills up, remaining players roll down to the Ranger Tier. Arcade Ranger Tier (75–94 Arcade Points) The first 4,000 players to secure a spot (including those rolling down from higher tiers) get Arcade Ranger prizes. If this fills up, remaining players roll down to the Trooper Tier. Arcade Trooper Tier (50–74 Arcade Points) The first 6,000 players to reach or roll down to this tier will get Arcade Trooper prizes. How the Waterfall System Works: The first-come, first-served rule triggers at the highest level: the Arcade Legend Tier . There are 2,500 Legend prizes available. If you earn 120+ Arcade Points but miss out on those initial 2,500 Legend slots, you are automatically placed at the front of the line for the Arcade Champion Tier prizes. Your Arcade Points still count, but they now secure you a spot in the next tier down. This creates a chain reaction: if the Champion Tier prize pool fills up, any remaining players roll down to compete for the Ranger Tier prizes, and so on. Because every single tier has a maximum cap on available prizes, the earlier you lock in your points, the higher up the waterfall you stay , securing the best rewards before they run out! The Story Behind the Changes: If you missed our last update, here is the short story on why we’ve tuned up the system for 2026: Faster Deliveries: Knowing order quantities ahead of time allows us to pre-order your prizes and fast-track their shipment. We are completely rebuilding the back-end shipping pipeline to eliminate bottlenecks, ensuring your rewards hit your doorstep quicker. Total Fairness: New guardrails are in place to stop hoarders, protecting the rewards for real learners like you. We will be announcing rules related to prize eligibility and redemption soon. A Year-Long Marathon: Since this season spans the entire year, the point milestones are built for a steady, long-term journey. You’ve got plenty of time to crush it! Get all the nitty-gritty details on these changes here . Also, a full breakdown of the updated Arcade rules is landing very soon. Watch this space! How to Track Your Arcade Points & Arcade Prize Tiers: Check Remaining Spots: A real-time tracker will be updated every single week right on the Arcade Page . Check back weekly to see how many spots are left before a tier fills up! image 2048×602 86.2 KB Keeping Score: Keep an eye out for the monthly Arcade Insider email, which will show your exact total of Arcade Points earned so far this season. You can also track where you stand at this very moment by using the Points System outlined on the Arcade Page! Arcade Facilitator Program 2026: Your buddies in the Google Skills Arcade land on July 13, 2026, to ensure you never have to fly solo. You can meet them here ! observations.title: Infocus This Week: Google Skills Arcade June 2026
observations.text_excerpt: We don’t know about you, but the Google Skills Arcade Team is still processing January. How are we already halfway through the year?! If your cloud skills have been on the back burner, June is the perfect time to change that. We are kicking off the month with three incredible new games in the Google Cloud Skills Arcade 2026 . Whether you’re trying to build elite serverless apps, mess around with pre-trained AI, or lock down massive data pipelines, there is something awesome waiting for you this week. Arcade Adventure: App Dev and Cloud Observability Writing code is just the first step; you also need to know how to deploy it smoothly and keep it running at its best. In this adventure, you’ll get started with serverless setups by running code on Cloud Run Functions and connecting your services using Google Cloud Pub/Sub. From there, you’ll work on the operations side—building out clean development environments, keeping tabs on multiple projects at once, and setting up smart alerts so you can spot and fix issues early. With a couple of challenge labs thrown into the mix, you’ll walk away with the skills needed to build, monitor, and scale apps on Google Cloud. Arcade Voyage: Identity Management and Pre-trained AI APIs Keeping your cloud resources secure and making your apps smarter are two essential skills for any cloud developer. In this voyage, you’ll start with the security fundamentals, learning how to configure service accounts, manage IAM permissions using gcloud, and set up custom roles. Once you’ve secured your environment, you’ll work with Google Cloud’s pre-trained AI tools—converting text to synthetic speech, translating languages on the fly, and transcribing audio files into text. Complete with two practical challenge labs to test your skills, you’ll walk away knowing how to safely manage access to your cloud project while adding powerful language and speech features to your applications. Arcade Trail: Data Engineering and Information Protection Raw data is only useful if it is clean, structured, and secure. In this track, you’ll start by processing and preparing data using Dataprep, Dataflow templates, and Apache Spark. You’ll learn how to clean up datasets so they are ready for machine learning models. From there, you’ll focus on security by working with tools that find and mask sensitive information like personal IDs and credentials. You’ll practice redacting critical details and creating safe, de-identified copies of your data in Cloud Storage. By finishing the hands-on challenge labs, you’ll show you can handle big data workflows while keeping confidential information completely safe. Which one are you jumping into first? Let’s make June a massive month for learning! Drop a comment below to share your learning goals for the month, or connect with a peer in the community to tackle these challenges together. Every game you complete is a major step forward in your cloud journey! Game On!

observations.title: Infocus This Week: Google Skills Arcade July 2026
observations.text_excerpt: Imagine walking into a brainstorming session where the team is throwing out brilliant ideas for a new project. The excitement is high, but the timeline is tight—everyone assumes it will take weeks of backend development, strict compliance reviews, and complex access configurations before anyone sees a working prototype. Instead of waiting, you leverage the right cloud tools to build the app framework, secure the storage backend, and set up the team’s workspace collaboration before the week is even over. Turning ideas into immediate, secure reality is what top-tier cloud management is all about, which is why three brand new games for July just landed in the Google Skills Arcade. Designed to drop you directly into realistic operational scenarios. Whether you’re deploying event-driven applications without writing massive codebases, enforcing ironclad data compliance protocols, or securing collaboration ecosystems from the ground up, the live roster is ready. Look at what just went live this month and pick your arena. Arcade Adventure: Low-Code Development Who says you need a mountain of complex code to build elite software? This adventure is your absolute fast lane to rapid app development and lean automation. You’ll first jump straight into Google AppSheet, deploying fully functional, production-ready apps without writing a single line of syntax. Once your frontend is live, you’ll master the backend with Cloud Run Functions—deploying event-driven code seamlessly via both the console and the command line. Backed by two hands-on challenge labs, this quest is your golden ticket to shipping sleek apps and scaling them effortlessly on Google Cloud. Arcade Voyage: Cloud Storage and Data Governance Data is the lifeblood of any modern organization, which means leaving its security to chance is a critical mistake. In this voyage, you will master the mechanics of enterprise-grade storage, automating cloud bucket management via APIs and the CLI while locking down compliance protocols with Bucket Lock. From there, you’ll pivot to advanced threat mitigation, configuring Sensitive Data Protection Discovery to automatically scan, flag, and catalog hidden risks across BigQuery and Cloud Storage. Hit both challenge labs to prove you can safeguard critical assets across an entire cloud ecosystem. Arcade Trail: Google Workspace Administration Managing a massive digital ecosystem isn’t just about keeping the lights on—it’s about building an airtight launchpad for secure global collaboration. In this trail, you’ll take control of the Google Workspace Admin Console, engineering user provisioning and granular application security from the absolute ground up. Then, you’ll switch gears to digital education, weaponizing tools like Google Meet and Google Classroom to transform basic virtual spaces into fortress-secure digital classrooms. Complete with two challenge labs, this track is your blueprint for running enterprise-scale workspaces with total authority. Every challenge lab you complete isn’t just about scoring Arcade Points—it’s about building the exact muscle memory required to solve high-stakes problems in real deployment environments. This July, focus on bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and the actual hands-on engineering that companies need right now. Share your learning goals in the comments, connect with Arcade Players in the community to tackle the tougher environments together, and start turning cloud concepts into concrete production-ready skills. See you in the Cloud!

You could read the manual ten times, memorize every single traffic rule, and study how the engine works down to the last bolt. But none of that actually meant you knew how to drive. The real confidence only came the moment you finally sat in the driver’s seat, put your hands on the wheel, and took off. Building tech skills works the exact same way. Right now, everyone is talking about AI. But there is a huge difference between just typing prompts into a chatbot and actually sitting in the driver’s seat to build an entire AI system yourself. When you first open the Google Skills Arcade page and look at those Arcade Prize Tiers and the Arcade Points needed, it can feel like looking at a massive roadmap before a journey. It’s easy to feel intimidated. But the goal here isn’t just to accumulate Arcade Points—it’s to empower you to build real, industry-ready technology. That is exactly why the Arcade Facilitator 2026 Bonus Milestone was created. observations.title: InFocus This Month: Google Skills Arcade 2026
observations.text_excerpt: Ever spent hours tracking down why a deployment broke? Or hesitated for a split second before hitting “share” on a sensitive dataset? This month in the Google Skills Arcade, we are moving past the standard tutorials and tackling the actual workplace friction that slows you down. We’re zeroing in on the skills that make your daily work smoother, safer, and infinitely less stressful. Here is what we are conquering this month: Arcade Adventure: Data Vault Sharing data outside your organization usually involves jumping through endless compliance hoops or relying on clunky workarounds. What if you could just serve up exactly what your partners need, with zero risk to your underlying infrastructure? This challenge shows you how to pull that off. We’ll dive into setting up secure BigQuery pipelines so you can confidently deliver insights to clients while keeping your private tables completely locked down. By the end of this adventure, you will know how to build a scalable Analytics-as-a-Service architecture that keeps both your external partners and your internal security team completely happy. Arcade Voyage: Google Sheets We have all stared at a massive, chaotic spreadsheet and wondered where to even begin. It is time to take back control and turn that raw grid into a serious business intelligence engine. This challenge is all about bulletproofing your data and making it tell a clear story. You will figure out how to lock down your inputs so messy data never makes it into your system in the first place. From there, we will explore the advanced formulas and dynamic charting techniques that reveal actual business trends. If you want to build dashboards that make leadership go “wow” instead of “what am I looking at?” , this is your path. Arcade Trail: Cloud Delivery Systems “It works on my machine” is a phrase we all want to leave in the past. If you want to push updates rapidly without breaking production, you need an automated, rock-solid release process. In this challenge, we are demystifying CI/CD on Google Cloud to banish deployment anxiety for good. You’ll learn how to neatly manage your container images, wire up automated pipelines for Kubernetes, and use Cloud Deploy to confidently promote your code across different environments. The ultimate goal? Smooth, predictable deployments that run like clockwork every single time. Over to you! Pick your path, dive into the Arcade, and let’s start eliminating those workplace hurdles this month. **Bonus Drop! ** Did last month’s early Arcade Trail closure catch you by surprise? We’ve spun up a special encore run so you can snatch up that missing point, and keep your Arcade streak alive! A Quick Note on Arcade Points: Just a friendly reminder that the Google Skills Arcade does not have an official points calculator. We kindly ask that you avoid reaching out to our support teams with queries based on point totals calculated on third-party websites. To track your progress accurately, please rely only on the official calculation methods detailed on the Google Skills Arcade page, along with your Arcade Insider emails (if you haven’t checked yet, August’s issue has already landed in your inbox ). Happy learning! See you in the Cloud!

observations.text_excerpt: If you climbed all the way to the Legend Tier , you didn’t do it by waiting for perfect conditions—you built through the storm. To kick off the very first swag drop of 2026, we’re outfitting you with the ultimate barrier against the elements: The Arcade Weather-Shield Jacket. Throw it on for your morning commute or wear it to work—either way, it’s a flex you actually had to earn. Placed in the Champion and Legend Tier, here’s why it belongs in your rotation: Storm-ready weave: Repels light rain and shuts down gusting winds before they hit your layer. Official branding: Clean Google Cloud logo on the left chest paired with the super cloud logo on the sleeve. Total draft block: High stand-up collar, custom Velcro cuffs, and a ribbed elastic hem lock warmth in and the weather out. Secure cargo: Deep zippered hand-warmer pockets keep your phone, keys, and hands safe from cold snaps. Weightless mobility: Technical performance without the heavy winter bulk—made to keep you moving. Don’t leave this sitting on the table because it is built for whatever the forecast throws at your deploy! If you’re new to the tier system, here’s how the Prize Tiers work: think of it like a “Snowball”. You never have to pick and choose between tiers when you rank up; your rewards just keep rolling forward and getting bigger: Arcade Trooper Tier: This is your foundational milestone. Once you hit this points threshold, you unlock the core swag pack filled with essential Google Skills Arcade gear. Arcade Ranger Tier: The natural next step for participants pushing past the basics. It’s designed for players who stay consistent, bank more Arcade Points, and put in that extra effort across challenges—unlocking everything from the Trooper Tier plus an additional bonus reward on top. Arcade Champion Tier: A major leap into the upper ranks. Hitting the Arcade Champion Tier takes serious dedication, unlocking a high-tier collection of premium Google Skills Arcade gear that really stands out. Arcade Legend Tier: The absolute summit of the Google Skills Arcade. Reserved exclusively for the users who max out their points to finish at the very top, scoring everything from the Champion Tier plus an exclusive Legend-only reward. In simple terms, you never miss out when you rank up. Reaching Arcade Ranger Tier gives you all the Arcade Trooper Tier swags plus extra gear, and reaching the Arcade Legend Tier gives you the complete Arcade Champion Tier pack plus exclusive rewards waiting at the very top. Please note that Arcade Trooper and Arcade Ranger prizes won’t snowball into the Arcade Champion and Arcade Legend Tiers. That means every single badge and point you bank right now isn’t just getting you closer to the jacket—it’s building up the whole pile of gear waiting for you on the other side. The clock’s ticking, the next challenge is waiting, and that Arcade Legend spot won’t claim itself. Go get it! See You In The Cloud

observations.title: InFocus This Week: Google Skills Arcade October 2026
observations.text_excerpt: October is here, and we’re dealing with the real scares: mysterious production bugs and phantom memory leaks. If you want to spend the spooky season exorcising your worst cloud nightmares instead of getting haunted by broken builds, we’ve got you covered. This month’s Google Skills Arcade is fully loaded to help you conquer your infrastructure fears—no tricks, just treats for your resume. Here’s what’s brewing this October: Arcade Adventure: Google Cloud ML APIs Query Google Cloud endpoints directly from APIs Explorer, teach your apps to read multilingual text and recognize facial features, and turn spoken words into real-time transcripts. Knock out both challenge labs unassisted to prove you can turn unstructured sight and sound into clean cloud intelligence. Arcade Voyage: Language, Voice, and Multimodal Processing Analyze sentiment and extract entities with the Cloud Natural Language API while scaling workflows with Apache Spark. From there, generate lifelike audio using Text-to-Speech, bridge global barriers with translation, and annotate video streams via Video Intelligence. Arcade Trail: Containers & Load Balancing Build and scale production-ready environments by packaging apps with Docker, deploying on GKE, and orchestrate containerized services. Next, configure regional and global HTTPS load balancers, and set up Cloud Monitoring to track health and latency. The games are open and waiting in the dark whenever you are ready. Grab some candy, jump into a lab, and banish those bugs this October! See you in the Cloud!
